title: Lymphocyte Proliferation in Poultry Species
author: Ahmed O.Abass
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xjpfkmn
materials: The heparinized blood samples were added to separation medium Histopaque®-1077 (cat# 10771, Sigma, USA).
Peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) were isolated and washed twice with RPMI-1640 (Invitrogen Corp., Grand Island, NY, USA) and then re-suspended in 2 ml of RPMI-1640 complete culture medium.

A 50 μl of either Concanavalin-A (Con-A, 45 μg/ml, cat# C5275, Sigma, USA) or Lipopolysaccharide (LPS, 10 μg/ml, cat# L4391, Sigma, USA) was added to selected wells to induce the proliferation of T lymphocyte and B lymphocyte, respectively.
Control wells received 50 μl of RPMI-1640 medium.
After incubation, 15 μl of 3-[4,5-dimethylthiazol]-2,5-diphenyltetrazolium bromide (MTT, 5 mg/ml, cat# M2128 , Sigma, USA) was added to each well and the cells were incubated for another 4 h.

steps.title: Centrifuge Samples
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the samples at 1030 xg for 20 min at 4°C.

steps.title: Plate Lymphocytes
steps.instruction: Detect viable lymphocytes using Trypan Blue dye and plate them in triplicate wells of a 96-well plate at a density of 1×10^6 cells per well.

steps.title: Incubate Cells
steps.instruction: Incubate the cells for 48 h at 42 °C with 5% CO2.

steps.title: Lyse Cells and Solubilize Crystals
steps.instruction: Add 100 μl of 10% sodium dodecyl sulfate dissolved in 0.04 M HCl solution to each well to lyse the cells and solubilize the MTT crystals.

steps.title: Measure Absorbance
steps.instruction: Record the absorbance at 570 nm using an automated ELISA microplate reader (ChroMate® Microplate Reader-4300, Awareness Technology Inc., Palm City, FL, USA).

steps.title: Calculate Stimulating Index
steps.instruction: Calculate the Stimulating index (SI) for either T or B cells using the formula: SI = OD570 (stimulated cells) / OD570 (unstimulated cells).
